He was an accountant in the service of Daulat Khan Lodi before joining the company of the Muslim bard Mardana. Mentioned in the writings of both Homer and Hesiod, it was destroyed in warfare by the Aetolians in 219 BCE, but probably restored later, including its magnificent theater built by Pyrrhus in the 3rd century BCE.
